note: Curated calendar of expo-centre trade shows, consumer fairs and conferences in Pakistan. Dates are indicative annual schedules; always confirm with the organiser before travelling.

events.title: Solar & Energy Storage, Electric Vehicles, & Fire Safety Expo
events.description: Trade expo for solar power, battery storage, electric vehicles and fire-safety equipment, with exhibitor stalls, product launches and B2B matchmaking for installers, EPCs and distributors.

events.title: 10th Pakistan Industrial Expo
events.description: Tenth edition of the country's industrial machinery showcase, covering CNC tools, automation, packaging lines, pumps and engineering services for small and large manufacturers.

events.title: Plastics, Rubber and Sealant Pakistan Expo (PRSPAK) & Green Pakistan Expo
events.description: Combined plastics, rubber and sealant trade fair running alongside a sustainability expo on recycling, clean energy and green manufacturing practices.

events.title: IAPEX Lahore (Architecture & Building Expo)
events.description: Architecture and building materials expo bringing together architects, interior designers, developers and construction suppliers, with design talks and product pavilions.

events.title: Hum Masala Family Festival
events.description: Two-day family food and lifestyle festival with cooking competitions, celebrity chef appearances, live music and children's activity zones.

events.title: Pakistan Plastic Show & 12th Pakistan Mega Leather Show
events.description: Four-day industrial fair pairing the national plastic industry exhibition with the Pakistan Mega Leather Show, covering machinery, raw materials, footwear and leather goods.

events.title: Lahore International Book Fair (LIBF)
events.description: Five-day book fair with local and international publishers, author signings, poetry sessions, children's reading corners and panel discussions on education and publishing.

events.title: Pakistan Auto Show (PAPS)
events.description: Consumer and trade auto show with new model launches, motorcycles, auto parts, aftermarket accessories and test-drive zones.

events.title: Lahore International Food & Beverage Expo
events.description: Food, beverage and hospitality trade show for restaurant chains, hotel suppliers, food-processing machinery, packaging and halal-certified producers.

events.title: Lahore Property & Build Expo
events.description: Property and construction expo featuring housing schemes, developers, building materials, home automation and financing desks for first-time buyers.

events.title: Pakistan Education & Careers Expo — Lahore
events.description: Education and career fair with university stalls, scholarship guidance, skills institutes, CV clinics and on-the-spot interviews with employers.

events.title: ITIF Asia (International Industrial Engineering Exhibition)
events.description: International industrial engineering exhibition covering machine tools, process equipment, automation, hydraulics and industrial safety systems.

events.title: IDEAS (International Defence Exhibition and Seminar)
events.description: Pakistan's flagship defence exhibition and seminar, with international delegations, equipment displays and a conference track on security and technology cooperation.

events.title: Textile Asia, Clothing Fabrics & Textiles Asia, and DyeStuff & Chemical Asia
events.description: Co-located textile machinery, fabrics and dye-chemical expos serving mills, garment exporters and fashion manufacturers, with technical seminars on sustainable processing.

events.title: International Consumer Product Fair (ICPF), Gift Asia & Beauty Asia
events.description: Consumer goods, gifts and cosmetics fair timed for the winter shopping season, with retail stalls, trade buyers' day and product demonstrations.

events.title: Build Asia
events.description: Construction, building materials and property exhibition with equipment displays, contractor workshops and sessions on low-cost and disaster-resilient housing.

events.title: Karachi International Book Fair (KIBF)
events.description: One of Pakistan's largest book fairs, with publisher stalls, Urdu and English literature sessions, children's programmes and a dedicated academic hall.

events.title: Pakistan Travel Mart
events.description: Travel and tourism trade mart connecting tour operators, airlines, hotels and destination boards, with consumer travel deals on the final day.

events.title: FoodAg Pakistan (Agriculture & Food Expo)
events.description: Agricultural and food export expo with machinery, seeds, irrigation systems, cold-chain suppliers and buyer delegations from the Gulf and Central Asia.

events.title: Pharma & Healthcare Expo Pakistan
events.description: Pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical devices and hospital equipment exhibition with clinician workshops and a healthcare investment conference.

events.title: Pakistan Education Expo — Karachi
events.description: University and college admissions fair with study-abroad advisors, scholarship desks, test-prep institutes and career counselling sessions for students.

events.title: Karachi Auto & Transport Expo
events.description: Auto, commercial transport and logistics expo covering passenger vehicles, trucks, fleet-management software, tyres and spare-parts suppliers.

events.title: International Academic & Tech Conference Series
events.description: A five-week run of linked academic and technology conferences — AI, renewable energy, public health and social sciences — hosted across convention venues with paper presentations and workshops.

events.title: Islamabad Literature Festival & Corporate Summits
events.description: Literature festival with author panels, poetry readings and book launches, plus parallel corporate summits on media, marketing and creative industries.

events.title: Pakistan Digital & IT Expo
events.description: Software, fintech and IT-services expo with startup pitches, freelancing clinics, government digital-services stalls and recruiters hiring tech talent.

events.title: Islamabad Property Expo
events.description: Property exhibition for Islamabad and Rawalpindi developments, with developer booths, mortgage advisers, legal clinics and overseas-Pakistani investment desks.

events.title: Pakistan Health & Wellness Expo
events.description: Health and wellness expo with hospital and diagnostics stalls, fitness and nutrition brands, free screening camps and public-awareness talks.

events.title: Islamabad Education & Careers Expo
events.description: Admissions and careers fair for school leavers and graduates, with university representatives, scholarship guidance and employer recruitment desks.

events.title: Pakistan Defence & Aerospace Technology Showcase
events.description: Defence and aerospace technology showcase with systems displays, research posters, procurement briefings and a student innovation competition.

events.title: Regional Agricultural & Agro-Industrial Showcase
events.description: South Punjab agricultural showcase for cotton, mango and citrus growers, drip-irrigation suppliers, tractor dealers and SME financing desks.

events.title: Multan Trade & Industry Expo
events.description: Regional trade and industry expo connecting manufacturers, wholesalers and logistics firms from Multan, Bahawalpur and Dera Ghazi Khan divisions.

events.title: South Punjab Textile & Garments Expo
events.description: Textile and garment sourcing expo for spinners, weavers, dyeing units and stitching houses, with export-compliance and worker-safety workshops.

events.title: Faisalabad Textile & Garment Expo
events.description: Textile and garment expo in the country's largest textile hub, covering spinning machinery, fabrics, home textiles and export buyers' meetings.

events.title: Faisalabad Industrial Expo
events.description: Industrial machinery and engineering expo for Faisalabad's mills and SMEs, with automation demos, energy-efficiency audits and supplier matchmaking.

events.title: Pakistan Agri Machinery Show
events.description: Farm machinery show with tractors, harvesters, sprayers, seed drills and precision-farming technology, plus live field demonstrations.

events.title: KP Trade & Industry Expo
events.venue: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chamber of Commerce & Industry
events.description: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa trade and industry expo featuring marble, gems, handicrafts, food processing and cross-border trade services.

events.title: Peshawar Book & Culture Festival
events.venue: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chamber of Commerce & Industry
events.description: Regional book and culture festival with Pashto and Urdu literature sessions, handicraft bazaar, folk music and youth writing workshops.

events.title: Sialkot Sports Goods & Surgical Instruments Expo
events.description: Export-focused expo for Sialkot's sports goods, surgical instruments and leather industries, with international buyer delegations and compliance clinics.

events.title: Sialkot International Trade Fair
events.description: International trade fair showcasing Sialkot's export clusters — sports goods, surgical instruments, leather, gloves and packaging — with B2B matchmaking.

events.title: Rawalpindi Home & Lifestyle Expo
events.description: Home, furniture, appliances and lifestyle expo aimed at twin-city consumers, with winter-season retail deals and interior-design consultations.

events.title: Potohar Business & Technology Expo
events.description: Business and technology expo for the Potohar region, featuring software houses, e-commerce services, SME finance and startup pitch sessions.

events.title: Gujranwala Industry & Manufacturing Expo
events.description: Manufacturing expo for Gujranwala's ceramics, sanitary ware, engineering and steel clusters, with machinery suppliers and export documentation support.
